detail.anchors: O={(0,0)} and C={(0,1)}; the declared anchor-preserving automorphism is the identity.
detail.carrier_family: The unchanged PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2: V_n={(i,j):0<=i<=n+1,j in {0,1}}, h_i^j for 0<=i<=n, v_i for 0<=i<=n+1, d_i for 0<=i<n, split triangles for i<n and the unsplit frontier square q_n.
detail.common_cylinder_algebra: A_cyl^R488 is the algebraic union of bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant functions of finitely many integer coordinates ell_v and finitely many closed-face holonomy characters. The R-488 four-coordinate generators (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) are included.
detail.functional: Use exactly PAH-001 F_rho, including onsite, aperture stiffness, covariant matter edge and plaquette Wilson terms, with no added term or changed coefficient.
detail.generator_domain: D_(n,Q) is the finite-dimensional space of all bounded functions on the full displayed fixed-Q state space Omega_(n,Q), with L_n given by the unchanged PAH-001 directed-root midpoint rates.
detail.gibbs_norm: Use the unchanged PAH-OMC-010 normalized Gibbs weight and C_sw=540 only as a state-weighted domination input; C_sw is not an intertwining proof.
detail.limit: No infinite-volume, continuum, physical-sector or observation limit is taken in this packet. n is a finite refinement label and R is held fixed for the domain audit.
detail.neutral_refinement: I_(n,n+1) is the pointwise lift f composed with p_(n+1,n), where p retains every old geometric coordinate and drops the new column n+2 and newly split diagonal d_n; the dropped aperture, radial, phase and link coordinates are assigned neutral values only for the forward inclusion.
detail.regulator: Use the unchanged PAH-001 finite regulator and, for the R-488/R-490 path, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, Q=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=0 and all displayed couplings one; n>=2 and R_max=R>=1 are the only OMC-010 uniform labels.
detail.root_correspondence: On the image of the neutral inclusion, each retained old PAH root keeps its exact geometric label, admissibility, delta-F, endpoint mobility, midpoint rate and cylinder increment. Roots whose support is outside the interaction closure of f have zero f-increment. No source/rate is altered.

assertions.name: r488-generator-included

detail.projection_image: The declared neutral projection drops the new column, so the retained charge sum is 0, not Q=1.
detail.weak_l2_scope: The witness has strictly positive finite PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weight, so the full-domain lifted observable and its weighted L2 defect are undefined rather than proved zero. This packet does not assert that every image-restricted weak L2 limit fails.
